book.name: XHUN
book.title: QꞌU BꞌAꞌNLA CHAJ CHUSBꞌALTETZ U JESUUS ITZꞌIBꞌA U XHAN Unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Xhun tiꞌ u Jesús

content: Vikamebꞌal u Lázaro
As umaꞌl u naj uvaꞌ Lázaro ibꞌii, as aachꞌoꞌmik naj. As echenik naj tu u tal tenam uvaꞌ Betania tukꞌ unqꞌa tanabꞌeꞌ, u Taaeꞌ tukꞌ u Maꞌleꞌ.
As u Maꞌleꞌ uvaꞌ tanabꞌ u Lázaro, as ixojeꞌ uvaꞌ kat oksan u txꞌumtxꞌulla tzꞌakabꞌaleꞌ tiꞌ toj u Jesús. As kat itzajsa veꞌt ixoj taꞌn u xiꞌl iviꞌeꞌ.

As ichaj veꞌt bꞌen unqꞌa tanabꞌ u Lázaro umaꞌl uxhchil kꞌatz u Jesús. As ech bꞌex alpo veꞌt ileꞌ te Aak: —Pap, vixibꞌin u Taaeꞌ tukꞌ u Maꞌleꞌ uvaꞌ xoꞌn chit see, as chꞌoꞌm ni bꞌanon veꞌt naj,— tiꞌk u uxhchileꞌ tal te Aak.

As tul tabꞌi veꞌt u Jesús u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ tal bꞌen chaꞌma, as ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: —Yeꞌl u chꞌoꞌmeꞌ la koj chit olebꞌ tiꞌ ikam u Lázaro. Pet la oksal veꞌt iqꞌii u Tiixheꞌ tiꞌ uveꞌ tuk ibꞌan u Tiixheꞌ tiꞌ naj. As la ok veꞌt unqꞌii staꞌn, tan ineꞌ viKꞌaol u Tiixheꞌ,— tiꞌk Aak.
As kꞌuxh xoꞌn chit u Taaeꞌ tukꞌ u Maꞌleꞌ tukꞌ u Lázaro te Aak,
as tul tabꞌi Aak uvaꞌ nikat ichꞌoꞌn u Lázaro, as yeꞌl uvaꞌ yak kuxh koj el chꞌuꞌl Aak. Pet kaꞌvaꞌttel qꞌii atin kan Aak tu uveꞌ atikkat Aak.
As xamtik stuul, tal veꞌt Aak te unqꞌa ichusulibꞌeꞌ: —Koꞌnaj sviꞌ tu u Judea,— tiꞌk Aak.
As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa ichusulibꞌ Aak ileꞌ: —Chusul, ¿ma naal veꞌt abꞌen tu u Judea unpajte? As tul ni tal unqꞌa iqꞌesal unqꞌa tenameꞌ ayatzꞌpeꞌ taꞌn kꞌubꞌ,— tiꞌk chajnaj.
As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: —Ootzimaleꞌ setaꞌn uvaꞌ kabꞌlaval oora tuul u qꞌiieꞌ. As abꞌil uveꞌ ni xaan sqꞌiil, as yeꞌxhkam la itxꞌet toj, tan at veꞌt txijun tetz vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ.
Pet abꞌil uvaꞌ ni xaan aqꞌbꞌal, as la itxꞌet toj, tan yeꞌl u txijun tetzeꞌ at skꞌatz,— tiꞌk Aak.
As tul maꞌtik talat u Jesús u yoleꞌ, as ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ te unqꞌa ichusulibꞌeꞌ: —Kat vatyu vas qetz kꞌultziꞌeꞌ. Pet bꞌen in tiꞌ unbꞌeyat naj,— tiꞌk Aak tal tiꞌ u Lázaro.
As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa ichusulibꞌ Aak ileꞌ: —Pap, asoj kat vatyu veꞌt naj, as tuk bꞌaꞌnxoj najeꞌ bꞌa,— tiꞌk chajnaj.
Pet aꞌ uveꞌ tal Aak uvaꞌ maꞌtik ikam veꞌt u Lázaro. As ech koj unqꞌa ichusulibꞌ Aakeꞌ, tan vataꞌm chit veꞌt nik ibꞌan u Lázaro uvaꞌ nik tal jeꞌ chajnaj ste.
As tal veꞌt Aak isuuchil te chajnaj. As ech tal Aak ileꞌ: —Kat kamyu u Lázaro.
As nuntxuqꞌtxun stiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌl in at in tzitziꞌ, tan setiꞌ la txakonkat tiꞌ uvaꞌ la ekꞌujbꞌaꞌ ekꞌuꞌl sviꞌ. Pet koꞌnaj qila,— tiꞌk Aak.
As ech tal veꞌt u Maxh ileꞌ uvaꞌ Dídimo: —Koꞌnaj bꞌa unpajte. Eela kukam tukꞌ Aak,— tiꞌk naj tal te unqꞌa imooleꞌ.
U Jesús aqꞌol tetz tiichajil
As tul oon veꞌt u Jesús najlich u Betania, as tabꞌi veꞌt Aak uvaꞌ kajvaꞌxnik qꞌii imujax veꞌt u Lázaro.
As pal pokꞌoꞌchil iꞌl ixoꞌl u Betania tukꞌ u Jerusalén.
As estiꞌeꞌ yeꞌ saach unqꞌa aa Jerusalén ul yakꞌinsan taama u Taaeꞌ tukꞌ u Maꞌleꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat kam u Lázaro.
As tul tabꞌi veꞌt u Taaeꞌ uvaꞌ unbꞌiitik kuxh toon veꞌt u Jesús, as qꞌax tel chꞌuꞌl ixoj. Bꞌex ikꞌul veꞌt ixoj u Jesús tu bꞌey. Pet ech koj u Maꞌleꞌ tan kat kaa ixoj tu kabꞌal.
As ech tal veꞌt u Taa ileꞌ te u Jesús: —Pap, atik koj axh tzitzaꞌ, as yeꞌleꞌxh vunxibꞌineꞌ kat kami.
Pet ootzimal svaꞌn uvaꞌ kam kuxh bꞌaꞌnil la ajaj te u Tiixheꞌ as la taqꞌ Aak see,— tiꞌk u Taaeꞌ.
As ech tal Aak ileꞌ: —Tuk uloj taamaeꞌ vaxibꞌineꞌ— tiꞌk Aak.
As ech tal veꞌt u Taa ileꞌ: —Kano qꞌi. Ootzimaleꞌ svaꞌn uvaꞌ la chit ul taama vunxibꞌineꞌ tul la ul taama unqꞌa kamnajeꞌ timoxtel qꞌii,— tiꞌk ixoj.
As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: —Ineꞌ la ulsan taama unqꞌa kamnajeꞌ. As ineꞌ aqꞌol tetz itiichajil. As jankꞌal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ la ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ ikꞌuꞌl sviꞌ as at chit itiichajileꞌ, kꞌuxh maꞌt ikameꞌ.
As jankꞌal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ isleꞌle as kꞌujleꞌl ikꞌuꞌl sviꞌ, as yeꞌxh jatueꞌ la kam u taanxelaleꞌ vatz u Tiixheꞌ. ¿Ma nanima u yoleꞌ uveꞌ ni val see?— tiꞌk u Jesús.
As ech tal u Taa ileꞌ: —Kano, Pap. Kat unnimaleꞌ uvaꞌ axheꞌ u Cristo. As axheꞌ viKꞌaol u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ kat ulyu vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ,— tiꞌk ixoj.
Ni toqꞌ u Jesús tiꞌ u Lázaro
As tul kuxh tal u Taaeꞌ u yoleꞌ te u Jesús, as qꞌaav veꞌt ixoj tu kabꞌal. Bꞌex ijas veꞌt ok ixoj te u Maꞌleꞌ uvaꞌ: —Il u Chusul kat ulya. As nimolo axh Aak,— tiꞌk u Taaeꞌ.
As tul tabꞌi veꞌt u Maꞌleꞌ u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ tal u Taaeꞌ ste, as qꞌax tel veꞌt chꞌuꞌl ixoj tiꞌ bꞌen tilat u Jesús,
tan yeꞌxnik oon Aak tu u tal tenameꞌ. Pet atiliktel Aak tu uveꞌ ikꞌulkat tibꞌ Aak tukꞌ u Taaeꞌ.

As tul til unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ atik tikabꞌal chaꞌma tiꞌ iyakꞌinsal taama chaꞌma vatz u txumuꞌmeꞌ, uvaꞌ qꞌax tel chꞌuꞌl u Maꞌleꞌ, as xekebꞌ veꞌt el tzan unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tiꞌ ixoj, tan kamal yakik ixoj tu uveꞌ mujlukat u Lázaro tiꞌ toqꞌ sijunal uveꞌ nikat tal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.
As tul oon veꞌt u Maꞌleꞌ kꞌatz u Jesús tu uveꞌ atikkat Aak, as kuꞌ veꞌt ixoj qaaloj vatz Aak. As ech tal veꞌt ixoj ileꞌ: —Pap, atik koj axh taꞌ tzitzaꞌ, as yeꞌleꞌxh vunxibꞌineꞌ kat kami,— tiꞌk ixoj.
As til veꞌt u Jesús uvaꞌ nik toqꞌ u Maꞌleꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ xekik tiꞌ ixoj. As ok veꞌt umaꞌl u mam txumuꞌm tu u taanxelal Aak tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat kam u Lázaro taꞌn u chꞌoꞌmeꞌ.
As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: —¿Katil qꞌi kat emujkat u Lázaro?— tiꞌk Aak. Ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchil ileꞌ: —Siꞌu, Pap. Koꞌ qileꞌ,— tiꞌk unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.
As oqꞌ veꞌt u Jesús.
As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchil ileꞌ: —Xoꞌnik chit najeꞌ te Aak,— tiꞌk unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.
Pet ech tal veꞌt kaꞌt unqꞌa uxhchil ileꞌ: —Kat ibꞌaꞌnxisa naj ivatz u tzoteꞌ. ¿As kam qꞌi uvaꞌ yeꞌ kat olebꞌ naj tiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ koj kat kam u Lázaro?— tiꞌk unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.
Ni tulsa u Jesús taama u Lázaro
Aal chit kat txumun veꞌt u Jesús. As jetzꞌen veꞌt ok Aak tziꞌ u juleꞌ uvaꞌ mujlukat u Lázaro. As jupik itziꞌ u juleꞌ taꞌn umaꞌl u nimla kꞌubꞌ, tan kꞌotik ok u juleꞌ vatz umaꞌl u piꞌun.

As ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —Eteesataj el u kꞌubꞌeꞌ tziꞌ u juleꞌ,— tiꞌk Aak tal te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ. As ech tal veꞌt u Taa ileꞌ te u tanabꞌ u Lázaro: —As xev veꞌteꞌ, Pap, tan kajvaꞌx qꞌii imujlu veꞌt naj,— tiꞌk ixoj.
As ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —¿Ma yeꞌ kat val bꞌa see uvaꞌ asoj la akꞌujbꞌaꞌ akꞌuꞌl sviꞌ as la chit eeleꞌ uvaꞌ nim chit talcheꞌ u Tiixheꞌ?— tiꞌk Aak.
As teesa veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ u kꞌubꞌeꞌ tziꞌ u juleꞌ. As sajin veꞌt jeꞌ u Jesús tu almikaꞌ. As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: —Taꞌntiixh see, unBꞌaal, tan kat aabꞌil vunyoleꞌ.
As ootzimal svaꞌn uvaꞌ naabꞌi vunyoleꞌ bꞌenameen. Pet tiꞌ kuxh veꞌt unqꞌa tenameꞌ uveꞌ at sunkꞌatz as ni val see, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la inima unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ axh kat chajon tzan in,— tiꞌk Aak.
As tul tzojpu veꞌt inachat Aak Tiixh, as taqꞌ veꞌt jeꞌ Aak tuul iviꞌ. As sikꞌin veꞌt Aak. Ech tal Aak ileꞌ: —¡Lázaro, elen chꞌuꞌl tu u juleꞌ!— tiꞌk Aak.

As el veꞌt chꞌuꞌl u Lázaro tu u juleꞌ. As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ: —Esaaputaj naj, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la xaan veꞌt naj,— tiꞌk Aak, tan bꞌochelik naj tu u maantaeꞌ tukꞌ iqꞌabꞌ tukꞌ toj. As jupik ivatz naj taꞌn suꞌt unpajte.
Nikꞌul tibꞌ iyol unqꞌa iqꞌesal unqꞌa tenam tiꞌ ikam u Jesús
As tul til veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ xekik tiꞌ u Maꞌleꞌ u nimla bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uveꞌ ibꞌan u Jesús, as yeꞌ saach unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ veꞌt ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak.
Pet ech koj kaꞌt unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ, tan bꞌex tal veꞌt te unqꞌa fariseo kam uveꞌ ibꞌan u Jesús.

As imol veꞌt tibꞌ unqꞌa iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh tukꞌ unqꞌa fariseo tiꞌ ibꞌanat inukꞌu. As ech tal veꞌt chajnaj ileꞌ: —¿Kam tuk kubꞌaneꞌ? Tan mamaꞌla kꞌuchbꞌal tetz u tijleꞌm najeꞌ nikꞌuch vatz unqꞌa tenameꞌ.

Asoj yeꞌxhkam kuxh tuk kubꞌaneꞌ, as tuk mox inima unqꞌa tenameꞌ viyol najeꞌ. As tuk uloj unqꞌa isol u ijlenaaleꞌ tu u Roma. As tuk teꞌpu chajnaj u kutostiixheꞌ. As la sotzsal u kutenameꞌ skajayil,— tiꞌk chajnaj svatzaj.
As yolon veꞌt umaꞌl u naj xoꞌl chajnaj uvaꞌ Caifás ibꞌii uvaꞌ atik ok siqꞌesalil oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh tu u yaabꞌeꞌ. As ech tal naj ileꞌ: —¡Yeꞌ etootza uvaꞌ nim talcheꞌ u yoleꞌ!
¿As ma yeꞌ nepal stuul uvaꞌ aal bꞌaꞌneꞌ uvaꞌ la kam umaj naj tiꞌ u kutenameꞌ, aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌl u tenameꞌ la sotzi?— tiꞌk u Caifás.

Echeꞌ tal kuxh koj u Caifás u yoleꞌ tukꞌ itxumbꞌal. Pet tiꞌ uveꞌ naj iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh tu u yaabꞌeꞌ, estiꞌeꞌ kat tal veꞌt naj u yoleꞌ taꞌn u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ la chit kam u Jesús tiꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil.

As jit kuxh tiꞌ unqꞌa tiaal Israel la kamkat u Jesús. Pet tiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌl ixoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ la ibꞌaneꞌ taꞌn u Jesús, aqꞌal uvaꞌ unvatzul kuxh veꞌt unqꞌa tenameꞌ la ibꞌan vatz u Tiixheꞌ, kꞌuxh paxin tibꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ.
Estiꞌeꞌ ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ veꞌt unqꞌa iqꞌesal unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ la kam u Jesús.

As yeꞌ nikat ikꞌuch veꞌt tibꞌ u Jesús xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ. Pet el veꞌt chꞌuꞌl Aak tu u Betania. As bꞌen veꞌt Aak tu umaꞌt u tenam uvaꞌ Efraín, najlich veꞌt u tzuukin txꞌavaꞌeꞌ. As tzitziꞌ atinkat veꞌt Aak tukꞌ unqꞌa ichusulibꞌeꞌ.
As unbꞌiitik kuxh ilejat veꞌt u nimla qꞌiieꞌ uvaꞌ pascua,
uvaꞌ nikat inima unqꞌa tiaal Israel. As yeꞌ saach unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tzaa tulaj itenam tiꞌ tul tu u Jerusalén tiꞌ teesat el u vaꞌlexheꞌ stiꞌ vatz u Tiixheꞌ jaqꞌ u nimla qꞌiieꞌ.
As nikat ichuk unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ u Jesús xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ tu u tostiixheꞌ. As ech nikat tal ileꞌ svatzaj: —¿Kam ni tal etaama? ¿Ma tul u Jesús tu u nimla qꞌiieꞌ moj yeꞌle?— tiꞌk unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ,

tan maꞌtik talax el tzan te unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil taꞌn unqꞌa iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh tukꞌ unqꞌa fariseo, uvaꞌ: —Asoj at umaj ex ootzin tetz uvaꞌ kat atkat u Jesús, as la etal sqe, aqꞌal uvaꞌ jik kuxh qooneꞌ tiꞌ kutxeyat naj,— tiꞌk chajnaj.

footnotes.text: 11.10 U qꞌii uvaꞌ tal u Jesús, as aꞌ isuuchil uvaꞌ atik Aak xoꞌl unqꞌa ichusulibꞌeꞌ. As yeꞌ la kaꞌkabꞌin taama chajnaj tiꞌ u kꞌujlebꞌal ikꞌuꞌleꞌ. Pet ech koj u aqꞌbꞌaleꞌ, tan aꞌ isuuchileꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌl veꞌt Aak at xoꞌl chajnaj. As la kaꞌkabꞌin veꞌt taama chajnaj tiꞌ u kꞌujlebꞌal ikꞌuꞌleꞌ.

11.55 As jun yaabꞌ nik tulsa unqꞌa tiaal Israel skꞌuꞌl uvaꞌ yeꞌl unqꞌa bꞌaxa ikꞌaol unqꞌa qꞌesla ibꞌaaleꞌ kat yatzꞌpi taꞌn u ángel tul uvaꞌ kat el chꞌuꞌl u tenameꞌ tu u Egipto. As eyen tu Éxodo 12.1-36.
